prompt: In `packages/nana-stage/lib/blocks.mjs`, the exported function `clampText(text, maxBytes, what)` currently trusts its `maxBytes` argument. Add a guard so that it throws a `TypeError` when `maxBytes` is not a positive integer (0, negatives, non-integers and non-numbers must all throw); a valid positive integer must keep working exactly as before. Then add a NEW test file at `packages/nana-stage/tests/clamp-guard.test.mjs` that exercises the guard and exits with status 0 when the guard is correct — it must genuinely fail if the guard is absent. `node packages/nana-stage/tests/blocks.test.mjs` must still exit 0, and you must not edit it. Change no other files. Reply with ONLY the word DONE.
note: The probe is copied in only AFTER the model has exited, so it can neither be read nor edited. It states the same contract the prompt states, and prints 13 PASS lines when the guard is correct.

checks.note: the guard must go in clampText, and no added line in the source may touch process/console/require — the new test file is exempt from the shape rule because writing a test IS the task.
the existing suite must still run every assertion, counted only from the test file the model may not edit
the bench-owned probe, under the same sentinel: 13 trusted PASS lines only if the guard genuinely behaves
the model's own test must run to completion under the sentinel and report no FAIL — no passLines, because the prompt never fixed a count

with the guard reverted to the pinned fixture their test must fail BY RUNNING: the sentinel's completion marker distinguishes a test that ran and reported a failure from one that died on module load or forced a status. A regex on stderr is not tamper-proof evidence.
